title: DetecDiv module descriptor v1
description: Static identity and discovery metadata for a DetecDiv MATLAB adapter. It does not describe backend installation, weights or scientific validation.

id.description: Stable, case-sensitive module identity, independent of installation path.

type.description: Technical module family, for example classifier or processor.

package.description: Canonical MATLAB package name, preserving its letter case.

adapterVersion.description: Adapter release version, or null when the adapter is versioned with its containing repository. This is not a backend or weight version.

capabilities.description: Discoverable possible capabilities. Effective inputs and outputs depend on node parameters and remain governed by the execution contract.

detecdiv.description: Declared DetecDiv compatibility constraint. Null means unspecified, not tested compatible with every release.

pipelineContract.description: v1 pilots retain the existing execution and pipeline contract. A future explicit contract requires a schema update.
